summary: Details the process of manually promoting individual or selected groups of students from one academic session and class to the next, with options for handling pending dues.
steps: Use the "Filter" option to select the 'From Class' (e.g., Class 1) and 'From Section' (e.g., A) of the students you wish to promote.
Select the specific student(s) from the displayed list.
Choose the 'To Class' (e.g., Class 2) for the selected students.
In the pop-up window, verify the 'From Session' (disabled, e.g., 24-25).
Select the 'To Class' (e.g., Class 2) and 'To Section' (e.g., A).
Set the 'Category' for the promoted student (typically "Old").
Choose the 'Promoted Status': "Simple Promote" (dues remain in current session) or "Promoted with Dues" (pending dues carried forward).
business_rules: Only active students can be promoted. Inactive students will be skipped.
The choice between "Simple Promote" and "Promoted with Dues" should be confirmed by the client/institute as it impacts fee collection.
Promotion will be skipped if the fee structure for the target class and session is not yet set up.
important_notes: The system will display a message indicating the status of the promotion (e.g., "Student updated", "Skipped", "Re-updated").
A "Skip" status often indicates a missing fee group for the target class/session.
Manual promotion is suitable for promoting a small number of students or when specific students require different due handling within the same class.
